in_hebrew.name: Abbey
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Abbey הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English term ‘abbe’ meaning ‘monastery’ or ‘meadow.’ In Christian tradition, an abbey is a monastery, especially for women. This name carries the spiritual connotation of devotion and commitment to a community.
